objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-modify-registry-disable-windefender-notifications
objects.description: The following analytic detects a suspicious registry modification aimed at disabling Windows Defender notifications. It leverages data from the Endpoint.Registry data model, specifically looking for changes to the registry path "*\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender Security Center\\Notifications\\DisableNotifications" with a value of "0x00000001". This activity is significant as it indicates an attempt to evade detection by disabling security alerts, a technique used by adversaries
